requirement_text.ISS-0332: Backfill routine for DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 2 for pre-existing tenants. Acceptance criteria: (AC1) backfill updates pre-existing tenants' DEFINITION_PROMOTED to schema_version 2; (AC2) R10 against a pre-existing tenant succeeds end-to-end; (AC3) idempotent/no-op on already-v2 tenants.

task.description:
Write regression tests for ISS-0332 at test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs (on branch feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826).

WF-03 Step 4 rule: the test must fail against pre-fix code (or a mutant) and pass against post-fix code. Since the fix adds a new module, the fail-first requirement is satisfied by mutating the shipped logic and recording which tests fail for each mutant.

Tests must cover all three acceptance criteria:

AC1 — Backfill updates pre-existing tenants:
- Test setup: provision a tenant and seed ONLY DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 1 (use Registry.register_type directly with schema_version: 1 attrs). Then call Backfill.run/1 with schema_version: 2 attrs. Assert: result is {:ok, %{updated: 1, skipped: 0}} and the tenant's DEFINITION_PROMOTED is now at schema_version 2.

AC2 — R10 against a pre-existing tenant succeeds end-to-end:
- This tests Letflow.EventStore.Registry.validate_payload/3 behavior. Set up a tenant with DEFINITION_PROMOTED at schema_version 1 only, then call Backfill.run/1, then call Registry.validate_payload('DEFINITION_PROMOTED', <payload with null review_id>, tenant_id). Assert: returns :ok (not payload_validation_failed).
- Note: before the backfill, the same call with null review_id should return {:error, {:payload_validation_failed, _}}. This is the regression test that proves the fix works.

AC3 — Idempotent on already-v2 tenants:
- Provision a tenant, register DEFINITION_PROMOTED at schema_version 2. Call Backfill.run/1 with schema_version 2 attrs. Assert: result is {:ok, %{updated: 0, skipped: 1}} (no error, the version-2 tenant is skipped).

Additional test — schema_version_not_monotonic skip:
- Provision a tenant, register DEFINITION_PROMOTED at schema_version 3 (hypothetical future version). Call Backfill.run/1 with schema_version 2 attrs. Assert: result is {:ok, %{updated: 0, skipped: 1}} (higher version is skipped, not an error).

Mutation testing requirement:
- After the tests pass on post-fix code, mutate Backfill.run/1 in at least TWO ways:
  1. Change the :duplicate_event_type_version case to return {:error, :should_halt} instead of :skipped. Record which tests fail.
  2. Change the register_type call to pass nil instead of registration.tenant_id. Record which tests fail.
- State these mutations and their failure results in the handoff result.summary.

Test file location: test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs
Module: Letflow.TenantProvisioning.BackfillTest
Use: Letflow.DataCase (for database isolation per test)
acceptance_criteria: test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs exists and covers all three ISS-0332 ACs
AC2 test explicitly asserts {:error, {:payload_validation_failed, _}} before backfill and :ok after backfill
AC3 and schema_version_not_monotonic tests cover the idempotent/skip paths
Mutation testing: at least 2 mutants applied and tested, results recorded in handoff
